positive.prompt: My ~/.codex directory keeps growing and the desktop app feels heavier. Assess what can be cleaned safely.
positive.reason: Requests a measured audit and cleanup of local Codex storage and runtime usage.

positive.prompt: Delete old archived Codex sessions, including completed subagent sessions, and compact the log database.
positive.reason: Requests permanent local task-history deletion and database maintenance.

positive.prompt: Why are there many Codex standalone releases and renderer processes, and which ones can I remove or stop?
positive.reason: Requests both release-cache and live-runtime cleanup within the skill boundary.

positive.prompt: Codex is consuming 4 GB of RAM after weeks of use. Help me restart it without losing active work.
positive.reason: Implicitly requests safe runtime cleanup even without naming the Codex home.

near_miss.prompt: Delete my cloud ChatGPT conversation history.
near_miss.reason: Cloud account chat deletion is not local Codex state cleanup.

near_miss.prompt: Find everything taking space on my Mac and clean the disk.
near_miss.reason: General operating-system storage cleanup is broader than Codex-owned data.

near_miss.prompt: Completely uninstall Codex and erase its credentials and settings.
near_miss.reason: Uninstallation and account reset intentionally remove configuration and credentials, which this skill preserves.

near_miss.prompt: A Codex task is stuck in running state; diagnose the task failure.
near_miss.reason: Diagnosing one malfunctioning task is not a storage or runtime cleanup request unless cleanup is separately requested.
